editorial.blurb: Fireside is a warm neighborhood spot where you can settle in for well-executed comfort food—steaks, pastas, and brunch—in a spacious room or nature-focused back patio.
editorial.insiderTip: Order in-house rather than delivery to ensure quality; dine-in guests rave about the blackened chicken pasta and smoked gouda mac and cheese, while the back patio with its plant walls and bird sounds is a hidden gem worth requesting.
signatureDishes: Smoked gouda mac and cheese with broccoli and chicken
